ipa.financial_contracts.eti_option.EtiFixingInfo

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.eti_option.EtiFixingInfo.

Syntax

EtiFixingInfo(
    *,
    average_type: AverageType | str = None,
    fixing_frequency: FixingFrequency | str = None,
    average_so_far: float | None = None,
    fixing_calendar: str | None = None,
    fixing_end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    fixing_start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    include_holidays: bool | None = None,
    include_week_ends: bool | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
average_type AverageType | str No None The type of average used to compute.
fixing_frequency FixingFrequency | str No None The fixing's frequency.
average_so_far float | None No None The value of the average_type
fixing_calendar str | None No None The calendar of the underlying's currency.
fixing_end_date OptDateTime No None The end date of the fixing period. Should be less or equal to the expiry.
fixing_start_date OptDateTime No None The beginning date of the fixing period.
include_holidays bool | None No None Include the holidays in the list of fixings
include_week_ends bool | None No None Include the week-ends in the list of fixings
